title: Best AI Conferences 2026 (Compare GTC, DevDay, Cloud Summits & More)
seoTitle: Best AI Conferences 2026: GTC, DevDay, Cloud Summits Compared | GlobalTechEvents
description: The best industry AI conferences for 2026 are the ones with clear AI depth, verified dates, and a fit for your role—starting with GTC, OpenAI DevDay, AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next, Microsoft Build, Databricks Data + AI Summit, SuperAI, CES, GITEX GLOBAL, and VivaTech. This guide compares them on who they are for, AI focus, city/timing, and rough cost band (as of 2026-10-14). Use it to pick 1–3 events, then track updates on the Global Tech Events calendar.

author.bio: AI entrepreneur, wild anthropologist, meditation practitioner

sections.heading: How we chose these conferences
paragraphs: This list is for industry and product AI events—developers, enterprise buyers, founders, and infra teams—not academic CFP calendars. We exclude NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, and similar research venues from the main table.

Every row maps to a GlobalTechEvents must-cover brand. Dates come from official sites only; if a date is unclear we write TBD instead of guessing. Cost bands are rough expectations ($, $$, $$$), not sticker prices.

As of 2026-10-14: several 2026 editions have already run (CES, GTC, Cloud Next, Build, SuperAI, Data + AI Summit, VivaTech, Dreamforce, DevDay). Upcoming in this window: Web Summit, AWS re:Invent, and GITEX GLOBAL. We still include held editions so you can compare the full year and plan the next cycle.

AI is the first SEO guide track on GlobalTechEvents. The product itself is a unified calendar of major tech events across cloud, hardware, startup, crypto, retail, security, and more—not an AI-only directory.

subsections.heading: Industry events only (academic venues stay out of this guide)
paragraphs: Research conferences matter, but they serve a different job (papers, CFP deadlines, peer review). This page answers which industry AI events are worth attending or tracking.

subsections.heading: Selection criteria: role fit, AI depth, geography, cost band, calendar reliability
paragraphs: We score each brand on who it is best for; whether AI is flagship or a track inside a broader tech show; city and travel load; rough pass cost; and whether dates are stable enough to put on a living calendar.

subsections.heading: As-of date and update cadence
paragraphs: Page as-of is 2026-10-14. GlobalTechEvents sweeps P0 brands weekly from official sites. Subscribe to the calendar or join the WhatsApp group when dates move.

subsections.heading: Site scope: AI is the first guide track; the calendar covers broader major tech events
paragraphs: Do not read this page as a rebrand. Use the Events Hub and calendar filters for MWC, COMPUTEX, LEAP, KubeCon, TOKEN2049, and other major tech with AI tracks.

sections.heading: Quick comparison table (2026)
paragraphs: Scan the table first, then jump to role or region sections. Dates marked Held mean the 2026 edition already took place as of this page’s as-of date.

sections.heading: Best by role
paragraphs: Most people should pick one flagship, one regional, and optionally one specialty—not every row.

subsections.heading: Builders, AI engineers, and agent teams
paragraphs: Start with OpenAI DevDay and Microsoft Build for builder/API/agent narrative, GTC for infra and research-to-product depth, Databricks Data + AI Summit for practitioners, and SuperAI for Asia industry networking.

subsections.heading: Enterprise buyers and IT leaders
paragraphs: Prefer AWS re:Invent and Google Cloud Next for hyperscaler roadmaps, Dreamforce for enterprise SaaS/Agentforce narratives, and GITEX GLOBAL for MENA enterprise and government buyers.

subsections.heading: Founders, operators, and press
paragraphs: CES for consumer and hardware AI launches, VivaTech and Web Summit for Europe startup attention, SuperAI for Asia founder density.

subsections.heading: Infra, hardware, and chip ecosystem
paragraphs: GTC is the flagship. CES is the consumer/hardware stage. COMPUTEX and similar hardware shows sit outside this main table—see the AI-tracks section and the calendar.

sections.heading: Best by region
paragraphs: Geography often decides more than brand preference. Cluster trips when cities overlap.

subsections.heading: North America
paragraphs: CES and re:Invent / Cloud Next lean Las Vegas. GTC is San Jose. Build, DevDay, Data + AI Summit, and Dreamforce cluster around San Francisco / Bay Area.

subsections.heading: Europe
paragraphs: VivaTech (Paris) and Web Summit (Lisbon) are the two Europe rows in this shortlist.

subsections.heading: Middle East and Asia
paragraphs: GITEX GLOBAL anchors Dubai / MENA enterprise. SuperAI anchors Singapore / Asia AI industry.

sections.heading: Conference snapshots
paragraphs: Short reads so you can decide go / skip / watch without opening ten tabs. Official dates only; verify on the organizer site before you book.

subsections.heading: CES — Las Vegas
paragraphs: Consumer and hardware AI launches with global press attention. Best for founders, operators, and product teams. 2026 edition: Jan 6–9, Las Vegas (held). Cost band $$$, expo-heavy. Go if you need launch theater; watch remotely if you only need headlines.

subsections.heading: NVIDIA GTC — San Jose
paragraphs: Flagship AI infra / hardware / research-to-product conference. 2026 edition: Mar 16–19, San Jose (held). Cost band $$$. Go if GPUs, AI factories, or physical AI are core to your roadmap.

subsections.heading: Google Cloud Next — Las Vegas
paragraphs: Cloud + Gemini / agentic cloud narrative. 2026 edition: Apr 22–24, Las Vegas (held). Cost band $$$. Go for Google Cloud stack decisions; skip if you are not in that ecosystem.

subsections.heading: Microsoft Build — San Francisco
paragraphs: Developer-first Copilot / agent / Azure story. 2026 edition: Jun 2–3, San Francisco (held). Cost band $$–$$$. Go for builders shipping on Microsoft AI.

subsections.heading: OpenAI DevDay — San Francisco
paragraphs: Builder / agent / API flagship. 2026 edition: Sep 29, Fort Mason, San Francisco (held). Go if you build on OpenAI APIs; otherwise watch the livestream recap.

subsections.heading: Databricks Data + AI Summit — San Francisco
paragraphs: Data + AI practitioners. 2026 edition: Jun 15–18, Moscone Center, San Francisco (held). Cost band $$$. Go if lakehouse / data platform AI is your day job.

subsections.heading: VivaTech — Paris
paragraphs: Europe startup + AI attention. 2026 professionals days Jun 17–19, public festival Jun 20, Paris (held). Go for EU founder and press density.

subsections.heading: SuperAI — Singapore
paragraphs: Asia AI industry / startup / infra networking. 2026 edition: Jun 10–11, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore (held). Go when Asia relationships matter.

subsections.heading: Dreamforce — San Francisco
paragraphs: Enterprise SaaS / Agentforce narrative. 2026 edition: Sep 15–17, San Francisco (held). Go for Salesforce ecosystem buyers.

subsections.heading: Web Summit — Lisbon
paragraphs: Broad major tech with heavy AI content. 2026 edition: Nov 9–12, Lisbon (upcoming as of 2026-10-14). Go for founder/press networking.

subsections.heading: GITEX GLOBAL — Dubai
paragraphs: Enterprise / government / startup AI with MENA gravity. 2026 edition: Dec 7–11, Dubai (upcoming). Go for MENA buyers and partners.

subsections.heading: AWS re:Invent — Las Vegas
paragraphs: Hyperscaler cloud + AI at maximum scale. 2026 edition: Nov 30–Dec 4, Las Vegas (upcoming). Go for AWS roadmap and partner density.

sections.heading: Major tech events with strong AI tracks (not AI-only)
paragraphs: MWC, COMPUTEX, LEAP, TechCrunch Disrupt, KubeCon, NRF, RSA, TOKEN2049, and Consensus often carry serious AI content without being AI-only brands. They stay on the GlobalTechEvents calendar—not inflated into this main table.

sections.heading: AI agent and builder specialty events
paragraphs: Watchlist (P1, not this H1): AI Engineer, Interrupt, HumanX, AGNTCon, The AI Conference, World Summit AI, The AI Summit. Expect a separate best AI agent conferences guide later.

sections.heading: How to use this shortlist
paragraphs: Treat the table as a decision filter, then move to a living calendar so dates do not go stale in a static article.

subsections.heading: Pick a flagship, a regional event, and a specialty
paragraphs: Example mixes: GTC + SuperAI + an agent meetup; re:Invent + GITEX; DevDay + Web Summit. Three is usually enough for a year.

subsections.heading: Budget and travel reality check
paragraphs: $$$ rows often mean flights, hotels, and multi-day passes. If budget is tight, watch keynotes remotely and spend in-person budget where hallway conversations matter most.

subsections.heading: Follow dates on the calendar or WhatsApp
paragraphs: Browse the Global Tech Events calendar, open the Events Hub, and join the WhatsApp community for date changes. This page’s as-of stamp is 2026-10-14.

faq.question: What are the best AI conferences in 2026?
faq.answer: For industry (not academic) AI, start with NVIDIA GTC, OpenAI DevDay, AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next, Microsoft Build, Databricks Data + AI Summit, SuperAI, CES, GITEX GLOBAL, and VivaTech. Pick by role and region. As of 2026-10-14, several editions have already run; Web Summit, re:Invent, and GITEX remain upcoming.

faq.question: Are NeurIPS, ICML, or CVPR on this list?
faq.answer: No. Those are research venues with CFP and peer-review rhythms. This guide covers industry, product, cloud, and startup AI events that help you decide whether to attend or track for work.

faq.question: Which AI conference is best for developers versus enterprise buyers?
faq.answer: Developers and agent teams usually get more from DevDay, Build, GTC, Data + AI Summit, and SuperAI. Enterprise buyers and IT leaders usually get more from re:Invent, Cloud Next, Dreamforce, and GITEX. Founders and press often prefer CES, VivaTech, and Web Summit.

faq.question: How often are dates updated?
faq.answer: This page shows an explicit as-of date (2026-10-14). GlobalTechEvents sweeps P0 brands weekly from official sites. For live changes, subscribe to the calendar or follow updates via the site’s WhatsApp community.
